info.title: MultiHopper API
info.description: REST API for scheduled multi-hop transfers on Solana.

hopsCompleted.description: Number of hops that have executed.

hopsTotal.description: Total number of hops in the route.

canRescue.description: Whether locked funds can be rescued.

canReclaimRent.description: Whether closed step account rent can be reclaimed.

routeInit.description: On-chain signatures for route initialization transactions.

sessionInit.description: On-chain signatures for session initialization transactions.

hops.description: On-chain signatures for hop execution transactions.

PreparedTxBundle.description: Bundle of unsigned transactions to sign and broadcast.

routeInitTxs.description: Transactions to initialize the on-chain route and add hops.

orchestratorInitTx.description: Base64-encoded transaction to initialize the orchestrator config. Only present if not already initialized.

sessionInitTxs.description: Base64-encoded transactions to initialize step state PDAs and pre-fund the keeper.

keeperFundingTx.description: Base64-encoded transaction to transfer SOL to the assigned keeper. Only present if keeper needs funding.

recentBlockhash.description: Blockhash used to build these transactions. Sign and broadcast before expiry.

lastValidBlockHeight.description: Last block height at which these transactions are valid.

resume.description: Snapshot of on-chain state used to build the bundle. Useful for debugging and retry logic.

nothingToDo.description: True if all steps are already complete — no signing needed.

amountRaw.description: Gross transfer amount in base units.

post.description:
Creates a new transfer and returns a quoted transfer object. The transfer is in `quote` status — call `/prepare` next to get the transactions to sign.

Idempotent via `externalId` — sending the same `externalId` returns the existing transfer.

tokenMint.description: The Solana mint address of the token to transfer.

amountRaw.description: Raw token amount as a string.

sourceOwner.description: Solana public key of the wallet that will sign and pay for the deployment transactions.

recipientWallet.description: Solana public key of the final recipient.

tokenSymbol.description: Token symbol (e.g. `"SOL"`). Optional, used for display purposes.

hops.description: Number of intermediate abstraction hops. Defaults to integration setting.

arrivalSeconds.description: Target transfer arrival time in seconds. Minimum: 60.

externalId.description: Your own identifier for idempotency (e.g. `"order_12345"`). Alphanumeric, `.`, `_`, `-` only.

tokenPriceUsd.description: Optional token price in USD for tier calculation. If not provided, resolved from Raydium.

get.description: List transfers with pagination and optional filters.

Retrieve a transfer by its internal ID. Returns extended fields including `phase`, `progress`, `recovery`, and `signatures`.

A companion endpoint at `GET /transfers/by-external/{externalId}` also exists.

200.description: Transfer object with extended phase and progress fields

post.description:
Probe on-chain state and build the unsigned transaction bundle for `sourceOwner` to sign. Returns all transactions needed to initialize the route, orchestrator, and step PDAs on-chain.

This endpoint is idempotent — calling it again generates a fresh bundle (new blockhash) that skips any steps already completed on-chain.

Report Solana transaction signatures after broadcasting prepared transactions. This endpoint is **resumable** — call it once immediately after broadcasting `keeperFundingTx` (with just `keeperFundingSignature`), then again at the end with all remaining signatures.

**`keeperFundingSignature` is required** whenever `/prepare` emitted a `keeperFundingTx`. Submit it immediately after broadcast (before route-init txs) to prevent double-funding on resume. Omitting it when required returns `MH_039`.

Transitions the transfer to `processing` once the full bundle is recorded. Can also be used to revive a `failed` transfer after re-broadcasting.

routeInitSignatures.description: Base58 transaction signatures for the route initialization transactions.

orchestratorInitSignature.description: Base58 signature for the orchestrator initialization transaction, if present in the bundle.

sessionInitSignatures.description: Base58 signatures for the session (step PDA) initialization transactions.

keeperFundingSignature.description: Base58 signature for the keeper funding transaction, if present in the bundle.

404.description: MH_036 — signature not found on chain

409.description: MH_035 — transfer not in a state that allows broadcast confirmation

422.description: MH_037 / MH_038 — transaction failed on-chain or did not invoke the MultiHopper program

post.description:
Build transactions to recover SOL locked in on-chain accounts (route PDAs, step state PDAs, keeper balance) for a failed or stuck transfer. The returned transactions drain funds back to `sourceOwner`.

Only available when `recovery.canRescue` is `true` on the transfer.
Confirm that rescue transactions have been signed and broadcast to Solana.

rescueSignatures.description: Base58 signatures of the submitted rescue transactions.

post.description:
After a transfer completes, build transactions to close step state PDAs and return rent to `sourceOwner`.

Only available when `recovery.canReclaimRent` is `true` on the transfer.
Confirm that rent reclaim transactions have been broadcast.

get.description: Get a usage and fee summary for your integration within an optional date range.

post.description: Registers a webhook endpoint. Returns a signing secret — store it securely, it is only shown once.

events.description: List of event types to subscribe to. Defaults to all events if omitted.
